source_identity: Late Gothic Mass water cruet, Kraków, circa 1500, National Museum Warsaw (SZM 1 MNW)
photo_subject_evidence: Single complete gilt Gothic Catholic Mass water cruet with handle, winged-figure lid, spout, relief decoration and foot; centre framed on pale grey-white museum background, no nearby separate articles.
image_quality: Technically legible, slight specular reflections/dark gilding; original is 1144px wide, less generous than other full-res images but sufficient for modest atlas presentation.
typology_warning: Unusually ornate Kraków circa-1500 Gothic historic water cruet; not representative of ordinary twentieth-century paired glass cruets. Explicit historical date label mandatory; do not infer typical 1962 Mass material/design from this exemplar.
